title: Nade Aliyan Aliyan ya ali
body:
Nade ali an aliyan ya ali (×4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Badshahe jinno bashar ya ali, Nade ali an aliyan ya ali (×2)
Lut gaya Zehra ka chaman Ya Ali, Nade ali an aliyan ya ali
Kat gaya Zehra ka chaman ya Ali
<<MINI>>
Nade ali an aliyan ya ali
<<DIVIDER>>
Karte hai Shabbir buka ya Ali, Nade ali an aliyan ya ali
kut gaya hulqoome Asghar Ya ali
<<MINI>>
Nade ali an aliyan ya ali
<<DIVIDER>>
Hogaye Abbas ke baazu juda, Nade ali an aliyan ya ali (X2)
Hogaye paband e rasan ya Ali, Nade ali an aliyan ya ali
Reh gayi pyaasi Sakina ya Ali, Nade ali an aliyan ya ali (X3)
* Aye pidar e Zainab e khasta jigar
<<MINI>>
Nade ali an aliyan ya ali (X2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Aapka jungle me luta saara Ghar, Nade ali an aliyan ya ali
Zainab o Kulsoom phiri dar ba dar, Nade ali an aliyan ya ali Aur Sakina ki bhi cheene gauhar, Nade ali an aliyan ya ali
<<MINI>>
Nade ali an aliyan ya ali (×4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Aapka farzand e Hussain e ghareeb
<<MINI>>
Nade ali an aliyan ya ali (X2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Be watano be kaso afaat naseeb, Nade ali an aliyan ya ali
Qatl howa dasht me woh bekhata, Nade ali an aliyan ya ali
Beh gayi har khoon pe tegh e jafaa, Nade ali an aliyan ya ali
<<MINI>>
Nade ali an aliyan ya ali (X2)
